notes.title: There’s something wrong with… a new upcoming horror game!
notes.notes:
After many months of work, we are thrilled to unveil the exciting details about our second game! "THERE’S SOMETHING WRONG WITH…" will be a short first-person horror experience where you navigate through dark tunnels, hide from a monstrous entity, and confront the unknown, unravelling the mysteries that lie ahead. The question is, will you be prepared to discover the truth, no matter how terrifying it may be?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43761820/dde2cc8f82b7198dcb1ecd116306e8c9ed170ca0.png[/img]

Opposite to our first production, “The House of E.”,  the new game will not feature a traditional Inventory system. By using a special tool called the Replicator, players will be able to copy specific elements of the environment and paste them onto other unique areas.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43761820/a2be8073379ed1289dccbf6952bcffc335c1fcef.png[/img]

The game will feature a save system and professional voice acting for its characters. Additionally, it will undergo localization efforts to make sure that players from different regions and language backgrounds can fully enjoy and understand the game's story, dialogue, and text.

[previewyoutube=lf7Ej3nfo48;full][/previewyoutube]

"THERE’S SOMETHING WRONG WITH…" will be available for free, as same as our previous project The House of E.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2836580/Theres_something_wrong_with/

notes.title: The House of E. OUT NOW
notes.notes:
Explore the darkest corners of the spooky mansion, you will collect items and solve riddles. Notes and newspaper pages will shed light on past events, and all combined will put you one step closer to discovering the truth. And in the end, you will have to decide not only about Emma’s fate.

[previewyoutube=jt7skcMZNrM;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: RELEASE DATE ANNOUNCEMENT
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce that The House of E. will be released on Steam on March 24, 2023.

The House of E. is a story-driven puzzle game with horror elements and a creepy atmosphere. You’ll play as David Adams who's looking for his missing sister in a spooky mansion owned by a famous novelist. Oh, and he disappeared as well - hmm... coincidence? There’s only one way to find out.  

If you are looking for a thrilling and captivating experience that will keep you hooked until the end, then don't miss The House of E..
